capabilities: Scan the local Wallpaper Engine wallpaper library without Wallpaper Engine running
Paint a frosted-glass wallpaper layer behind the workspace via CSS variables
Play video wallpapers as a real video layer behind the workspace
Extract native-resolution artwork from scene.pkg and frames from video wallpapers
Apply a theme-aware readability dim layer with cover, fill and center alignment
extras: Multi-platform project: the same wallpaper library and features also ship as a VS Code extension and a Codex desktop injector. Wallvia only reads Wallpaper Engine's files and is not affiliated with it. Obsidian install is via BRAT or manual file copy; documentation for each platform lives in separate sub-READMEs.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to use Wallpaper Engine wallpapers or animated backgrounds behind the workspace interface.

relations.evidence: Wallpaper Engine is a product of Kristjan Skutta; Wallvia is not affiliated with it and only reads its configuration files
The glass-wallpaper idea comes from the wallpaper plugins in the DSH ecosystem

summary: Applies Wallpaper Engine wallpapers as a frosted-glass background layer behind the Obsidian workspace, with still or playing video wallpapers.
